page.notes: The handwritten "11" at the top right corner is pen-written, not printed, and is left out. No running head is printed. The Greek word at the start of the §6 note, "καθ' ἐξοχὴν", is read from a faint and partly obscured print, so it is marked [?]. Other printed hyphens are kept as set ("commu-nione", "Te-stamenti", "comede-"). The printed "Vet.Test." and "Ecclesia utriusq;" are kept as printed. Some stains and show-through at the left edge are not transcribed.
